definitions.explanation: A job or career that requires specialized knowledge, training, or qualifications, such as law, medicine, engineering, or accounting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{専門職|せんもんしょく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。

{専門職|せんもんしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。

examples.english: Professional occupations such as doctors and lawyers enjoy high social trust.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧ (specialty; specialization) and ⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧ (occupation; job). Refers to careers that demand advanced education, specialized training, or professional certification. In Japanese labor classification, {専門職|せんもんしょく} is a distinct category from {総合職|そうごうしょく} (general career track) and {一般職|いっぱんしょく} (clerical track).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {専門職|せんもんしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧: to enter a professional occupation
- {専門職|せんもんしょく}⟦{大学院|だいがくいん}→大学院：04783_daigakuin⟧: professional graduate school
- ⟦{高度|こうど}→高度：00243_koudo⟧{専門職|せんもんしょく}: highly specialized profession
- {専門職|せんもんしょく}⟦{学位|がくい}→学位：10196_gakui⟧: professional degree

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧: specialist; expert — refers to the person, not the job category
- {技術職|ぎじゅつしょく}: technical position — specifically about engineering or technical work
- {総合職|そうごうしょく}: general career track — the management track in Japanese companies, contrasted with {専門職|せんもんしょく}
